# CMSIS device headers for the STM32H5

From ST's [cmsis-device-h5](https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis-device-h5),
tag v1.7.0, unchanged: the register definitions and nothing else. Only the H563
header and the two it needs are taken; the rest of the family can be added the
same way when a board with another part turns up. Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.md.
